derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

occurrences.text: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
